CustomField.description: Internal name for this page section, defaulting to 'New Page Section'. Used as the section's label in the page section configurator and Customize modal navigation (sectionTitle); it is not rendered to end users on the form. Edit it inline in the Component tab.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A short name for this section used only in the builder to identify it in the configurator list. It is not shown to people filling out the form; use the Header fields for visible titles.
CustomField.label: Title
